_note: The CITATION ZONE. Proven, procedurally-reusable code a NEW scene cites from prior tree nodes instead of rebuilding. A component earns its place by going green (or probe-verified) in one world AND being general enough to reuse. JS libs are imported; WGSL/SDF components compose procedurally (min/smin) into new geometry.

components.reuse: any world whose interactions are broadcast rays meeting planes (seeing-is-touching, hitscan, line-of-sight, trigger volumes)

components.proven: GPU probe — renders clean, visible, correct palette
components.cite: copy the fn into your LIB module; prefix-rename to avoid builtin/uber-shader collisions
components.compose: min()/smin() these to grow new worlds — components compose like paint, not sprites

components.proven: GPU probe — dark-pixel share doubled, reads as ink lines
components.cite: paste the tangent/bitangent normal-deviation block after your normal is known
components.reuse: unlit-white + black-line Antichamber look on ANY SDF scene

components.proven: self-hosted — the loop runs on MAP.self.json
components.cite: cp -r swarm/ into a new project; author its MAP.json; node swarm/loop.mjs
components.reuse: any project that wants a swarm work-graph: dock, derive-green, ideate, jump, heal, trace
